deviations.what: sap.m.Select.liveChange is @since 1.100 and its change event's previousSelectedItem parameter is @since 1.95 - both are what this sample demonstrates, so they are kept 1:1 and the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.100.

onChange and onLiveChange only toast the ids of the involved items. Both are composed on the client from ${$parameters>/selectedItem}.getId() and ${$parameters>/previousSelectedItem}.getId(), so neither needs a round-trip and the texts stay the original's.
Both client-composed toasts are unverified in a running system.
